each accelerator as a separate memory domain
physical and free memory per accelerator
device interconnect and negotiated link where observed
multi-host transport and link rate where applicable

multiHostGate.reason: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next has a reported llama.cpp RPC correctness failure for prompts above roughly 2K tokens on at least one distributed configuration.
multiHostGate.rule: No distributed performance number is admitted unless deterministic correctness canaries pass first.

claimBoundary: This recipe fixes model identity and a portable llama-bench workload. It does not pool independent VRAM domains, infer a hardware minimum from a reference machine, or convert incomplete external demonstrations into directly comparable measurements.
